R15C.scope: Authenticate R15B artifact, strict single-IF float32 SIGPROC parser and exact HTTP byte range reads, same-day controls; targeted 5 kHz replay.

R16C.scope: 11 precommitted 100 kHz centers 1200,1250,1450,1550,1650,1750,2300,4800,6500,8500,10500 MHz; require six compatible alternating scans per supported frequency, no post hoc frequency selection; reverse controls and top-five caps.

R17C.scope: Frozen R17B SHA256 ec33b218cf893bb6a0b1e5ae8c77c6d25cbefe04fa11a2d4a699cd143a3c168f; two fresh calibration targets and four distinct new evaluation targets; 95% calibration sensitivity, fixed thresholds before reading test powers; realized test sensitivities may differ. Post hoc equal recall ROC-style diagnostic separately labelled. Timing and per-target results; no training or promotion.

limitations: Actual data access and results pending. R15C supports only 32-bit one-IF SIGPROC format; incomplete coverage explicitly fails/gates.
R16C sparse windows, not continuous full band, support depends on archived cadence.
R17C synthetic injection recognition, not astrophysical origin classification; archive holdout, correlated samples, no outside custodian. No guaranteed equal test recall.
